final: WITH filtered_data AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, HGB, `T-BIL`, CRE FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'), with_ratios AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, HGB, CASE WHEN `T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND CRE IS NOT NULL AND CRE != 0 THEN CAST(`T-BIL` AS REAL) / CAST(CRE AS REAL) ELSE NULL END as ratio FROM filtered_data), group_stats AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) as avg_hgb, AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM with_ratios GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall_mean_val AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_mean FROM group_stats) SELECT COALESCE(group_stats.CENTROMEA, 'missing') as status, group_stats.avg_hgb, group_stats.avg_ratio, group_stats.avg_ratio / overall_mean_val.overall_mean as ratio_normalized FROM group_stats, overall_mean_val WHERE overall_mean_val.overall_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY status DESC    -- rows returned are the answer
